Admin.invAutoNote: The store pays this by KHQR and it's confirmed automatically. Nothing to do unless the money came another way.

Admin.payDescription: Today's payment attempts across every store. Read-only: a payment counts only when the provider confirms it.
Admin.payNeedsLookLink: This payment is waiting in Failed checks
Admin.payReadOnlyNote: Nothing can be changed here. Payments are confirmed by the provider's own status check.
Admin.chkDescription: Payment checks the system couldn't settle by itself and a person has to look at.
Admin.chkRule: A payment can't be marked paid by hand. It counts only when Bakong or PayWay reports the exact amount in the right currency — so here you can ask again, or close the case with a note.
Admin.chkExplain_provider_unreachable: The provider's status service kept failing, so we don't know yet whether the buyer paid. The order is still waiting. Ask again: if the payment is there, the order is confirmed.
Admin.chkExplain_amount_mismatch: The provider reports a payment, but not for the order's exact total. The order was not confirmed. The seller and buyer need to settle the difference or refund.
Admin.chkExplain_currency_mismatch: The provider reports a payment in the other currency. We never convert a payment to make it fit, so the order was not confirmed. The seller needs to refund it or agree with the buyer.
Admin.chkExplain_paid_after_expiry: The exact amount arrived, but after the code expired and the order was cancelled. The money is with the seller; they need to refund it or send the order anyway.
Admin.chkRecheckHelp: Asks the provider for this payment's status once more.
Admin.chkNoChange: Same answer as before. Nothing changed.
Admin.chkConfirmed: The provider now reports the exact payment. The order is marked paid and the seller has been told.
Admin.chkCloseHelp: When it has been dealt with outside the system. Say what was done. The order itself doesn't change.
Admin.roleHelp_owner: Can do everything, including adding and removing admins.
Admin.roleHelp_support: Helps merchants: plans, periods and KYC. Sees money screens but can't change them.
Admin.roleHelp_finance: Handles invoices and payment checks. Sees merchants but can't change them or review KYC.

Admin.bakConfirmTitle: Back up the whole database now?
Admin.bakConfirmBody: It takes about a minute and the shops keep working. It is written in the audit log.
Admin.bakStaleNewest: The newest good backup is from {when}.
Admin.bakStaleNone: There is no good backup yet.
Admin.bakStaleDo: Press Backup now, then check that the worker is running.
Admin.bakStaleTell: Tell an owner or support so they can back up now.
Admin.bakNoDownload: There is no download button, on purpose: a backup holds every buyer's phone and address, so it stays in the private storage.
Admin.bakKeptDays: {count, plural, =0 {Deleted tonight} one {# more day} other {# more days}}
Admin.bakEmpty: No backups yet. The first one runs tonight at 03:00.
Admin.bakFullBody: Restoring the whole platform replaces the live database, so it is never a button here. It is done by hand, step by step:
Admin.bakFullStep1: Restore the backup into a new, empty database.
Admin.bakFullStep2: Compare the counts it prints with the live site.
Admin.bakFullStep3: Switch the app over to the new database.
Admin.bakFullLink: Open the steps (go-live.md, "When something goes wrong")
Admin.bakTestLate: It is late — test a restore once a month.
Admin.bakShopBody: For when a seller deleted or broke their products or settings by mistake.
Admin.bakNever: Never restored: orders, payments, buyers, stock movements, subscription and invoices. They are records of what really happened.
Admin.bakShopSearch: Search by shop name or link
Admin.bakPart_products: Products, their options, prices, descriptions and photos
Admin.bakChange_changed: Goes back to how it was
Admin.bakPhotosNote: Photos come back if their files still exist. Photo files are kept at least {days} days.
Admin.bakSafety: Just before the restore, the shop's current catalog is backed up, so this restore can be undone the same way.
Admin.bakTypeSlug: Type the shop's link to confirm: {slug}
Admin.bakDoneBody: {store} is back to the backup from {when}. The seller was told on Telegram, and the audit log has the counts.
Admin.bakAlreadyRunning: A backup is already waiting or running.
Admin.bakWaitingLong: Still waiting after 2 minutes: the worker may be stopped, or backups aren't switched on (BACKUPS=on).
Admin.bakTestRecord: I tested a full restore today
Admin.bakTestConfirmBody: Only after you restored a backup into a new database and its counts matched the live site. It goes in the audit log.

App.offlineBody: Check your internet connection and try again.
App.loginSubtitle: New or returning — one button. No password.
App.telegramNotSetUp: Log in with Telegram isn't set up on this server yet.
App.loginFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
App.devLoginHint: Only on a developer's computer. Signs in as a test merchant without Telegram.
App.previewTitle: The rest of your dashboard is coming
App.storePaused: Your shop is paused, so changes can't be saved. Everything you added is kept.
App.photoUploadFailed: A photo didn't upload. Remove it and try again.
App.productLimit: You have {count} products — the most your plan allows. Everything you added stays.
App.productLimitSave: Your plan's product limit is reached, so this product wasn't added.
App.orderingSoon: Ordering online opens soon. For now, call the shop to order.
App.deliverySuggested: We suggested zones and fees for Phnom Penh and the provinces. Check them, change anything you like, then save — buyers can order once delivery is saved.
App.codOffWarning: With cash on delivery off, buyers can't order until KHQR is available. Keep it on to take orders now.
App.orderFailed: Your order wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again — you won't be charged twice.
App.orderMovedOn: This order changed meanwhile (maybe from Telegram or another phone). It's shown as it is now.
App.tooManyTries: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.

AdminApp.title: Admin
AdminApp.stepOneHint: Sign in with the Telegram account listed as an admin. Next you'll enter a code from your authenticator app.
AdminApp.telegramNotSetUp: Telegram login isn't set up on this server.
AdminApp.devLoginHint: Developer's computer only: step one as the platform owner. The authenticator code is still required.
AdminApp.notConfigured: The admin login isn't set up on this server (ADMIN_SECRETS_KEY is missing).
AdminApp.notAnAdmin: That didn't work. Only listed admins can sign in here.
AdminApp.locked: Too many wrong codes. The login is locked for 15 minutes.
AdminApp.expired: This sign-in has expired. Start again.
AdminApp.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
AdminApp.enrolBody: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
AdminApp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
AdminApp.cantScan: Can't scan? Type this key into the app
AdminApp.codeBody: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Khmio Admin. Lost your phone? Use a backup code.
AdminApp.backupBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. They are shown only now — keep them somewhere safe, not on the same phone.
AdminApp.savedThem: I've saved these codes somewhere safe
AdminApp.overviewDescription: How the platform is doing, what needs a person, and the latest admin changes.
AdminApp.attentionPaused: {count, plural, one {# shop is} other {# shops are}} paused — buyers can't order
AdminApp.attentionTrials: {count, plural, one {# trial ends} other {# trials end}} in the next 3 days
AdminApp.attentionMessages: {count, plural, one {# Telegram message} other {# Telegram messages}} could not be sent
AdminApp.audit_extended: Extended by {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
AdminApp.audit_admin_login_backup_code: Signed in with a backup code
AdminApp.merchantsDescription: Every shop on the platform. Open one to see its details, extend its trial or period, or change its plan.
AdminApp.extendDone: Extended by {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
AdminApp.changedMeanwhile: This shop changed meanwhile. It's shown as it is now — check, then try again.
AdminApp.notePlaceholder: e.g. Beta seller, paid by bank transfer
AdminApp.extendReopens: The shop is closed: it reopens for exactly these days, from today.
AdminApp.extendAdds: Added on top of the days left.
AdminApp.planHint: Paid plans only. From a trial, a new 30-day period starts today.
AdminApp.waitlistDescription: People who asked on the website to hear when a coming-soon product opens. Newest first.
AdminApp.waitlistNotAllowed: Only an owner or support can see the waitlist: it holds phone numbers.
AdminApp.settingsReadOnly: Only an owner can change these settings.
AdminApp.alertsHelp: The Telegram chat that gets platform alerts: messages that couldn't be sent, a failing worker, a locked admin login. Empty = alerts off.
AdminApp.betaHelp: While on, every shop gets the Basic plan's features and limits and nobody is charged. Turn it off when billing starts (Release 2).
AdminApp.betaOn: On — beta: no charges, Basic features for all
AdminApp.betaOff: Off — each shop's own plan applies
AdminApp.tooManyTries: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.
AdminApp.merchantsEmptyBody: Shops appear here as soon as a seller finishes the two setup questions.
AdminApp.auditSearch: Search by person, shop or action
AdminApp.auditLoaded: {count, plural, one {Newest # entry loaded} other {Newest # entries loaded}}
AdminApp.audit_store_telegram_group_linked: Linked a Telegram group for order alerts
AdminApp.audit_store_telegram_group_unlinked: Removed the Telegram group for order alerts
AdminApp.attentionWorker: The worker isn't checking in: Telegram messages and backups may have stopped

Share.title: Share your shop
Share.body: Send the link on Facebook, TikTok or Telegram, or print the QR code for your counter or a sticker.
Share.copied: Link copied — paste it in your post or chat.
Share.manual: Copy the link above by hand.
Share.qrAlt: QR code of your shop link
Share.qrBody: Buyers scan it with their phone camera to open your shop.

Telegram.title: Telegram alerts
Telegram.body: New orders arrive in Telegram with a Confirm button.
Telegram.privateOn: Alerts reach your own chat with the bot — you signed in with Telegram.
Telegram.privateOff: Sign in with Telegram to get alerts in your own chat.
Telegram.noGroups: No group yet. Add the bot to a group so your staff see orders too.
Telegram.step2: Choose your staff group and add the bot.
Telegram.step3: The bot says “This group will now get order alerts”. Done.
Telegram.linkExpires: The link works once, for 15 minutes.
Telegram.notConfigured: Telegram isn't set up on this server yet.
Telegram.buyerHint: A message each time your order moves on. No app or account needed.
Telegram.buyerPressStart: In Telegram, press Start. Didn't open? Tap the button above.
Telegram.buyerFailed: Couldn't make the link. Please try again.

SiteEditor.field_permission: The seller gave permission to show this
SiteEditor.typeHint_announcement: One short line above the header, on every visit.
SiteEditor.typeHint_hero: The big headline, a sentence, Mio or a picture, and buttons.
SiteEditor.typeHint_steps: How it works, in 3 or 4 numbered steps.
SiteEditor.typeHint_productCards: Khmio's products, from the product list.
SiteEditor.typeHint_features: Reasons or features, each with an icon and an optional picture.
SiteEditor.typeHint_promotion: Shows only between its start and end time.
SiteEditor.typeHint_plans: The Shop's plans; prices always come from the system.
SiteEditor.typeHint_questions: Questions and answers that open with a tap.
SiteEditor.typeHint_sellerStory: A seller's words — only with their permission.
SiteEditor.typeHint_closing: A last headline and button at the bottom.
SiteEditor.typeHint_waitlist: Name, phone and business type for a coming-soon product.
SiteEditor.discardBody: The draft goes back to what is published now.
SiteEditor.draftNote: You are editing a draft. Visitors see nothing until you publish.
SiteEditor.sectionsHint: Visitors see them in this order. Switch one off to hide it without deleting it.
SiteEditor.removeBody: It leaves the draft. The website doesn't change until you publish.
SiteEditor.fixBelow: Some fields need fixing — see the red notes.
SiteEditor.savedDraft: Saved to the draft — not on the website yet.
SiteEditor.seoHint: What Facebook and Telegram show when someone shares this page.
SiteEditor.publishBody: Visitors see this version within a minute. The one live now is kept in History.
SiteEditor.publishedNow: Published — the website shows it now.
SiteEditor.problemsBody: Every text needs Khmer and English, and every link must be a site page or an https address.
SiteEditor.historyHint: Every published version. Restore puts one back in the draft; publish to make it live.
SiteEditor.restoreBody: It replaces your draft. The website changes only when you publish.
SiteEditor.promoEmpty: No promotions yet. Add one to show a banner between a start and an end date.
SiteEditor.promoTop: At the top of the page
SiteEditor.promoPublishBody: This publishes every change on the {page} page, including this promotion.
SiteEditor.promoKept: Promotions are kept for the record: switch one off instead of removing it.
SiteEditor.promoSavedDraft: Saved to the {page} page's draft — publish it to go live.
SiteEditor.promoTimeNote: Times are Phnom Penh time. A promotion shows and hides by itself.
SiteEditor.picEmpty: No pictures yet. Add one to use it on the website.
SiteEditor.picFileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. It is made smaller before it is saved.
SiteEditor.picNotImage: That file isn't a picture. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
SiteEditor.picDescriptionHint: Say what the picture shows. Screen readers and search engines read it.
SiteEditor.picReplaceBody: The new file shows right away on every page that uses it: {pages}.
SiteEditor.picReplaceUnused: Nothing uses it yet, so no page changes.
SiteEditor.picReplaced: Picture replaced — the pages that use it show the new one.
SiteEditor.picDeleteBody: No page uses it, so nothing on the website changes.
SiteEditor.picInUse: In use — it can't be deleted.
SiteEditor.picMockNote: Mockup — uploaded pictures are kept in this browser only.

NotFound.title: We can't find this page
NotFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the shop may have closed or changed its link. Ask the seller for the new link.

ErrorPage.title: Something went wrong
ErrorPage.body: The page couldn't load right now. Your order and your data are safe — try again in a moment.

DevPhone.title: Open on your phone
DevPhone.description: Scan the code with your phone's camera — the phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this PC. The address is read fresh each time, so it works on any Wi-Fi.
DevPhone.qrAlt: QR code that opens {address} on a phone
DevPhone.noNetwork: This PC isn't on a Wi-Fi or network right now. Connect it, then reload this page.
DevPhone.helpTitle: If the phone can't open it
DevPhone.help1: Check the phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the PC, with mobile data off.
DevPhone.help2: The first time on a new Wi-Fi, Windows may ask to allow Node.js: tick Private and Public.
DevPhone.help3: Café or hotel Wi-Fi may block devices from each other: connect the PC to your phone's hotspot, then reload this page.
